additional_info.body:
Dear Simen Aarre,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Abhinav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P8 170000979
ChargerID/Serial No.
: MP / P8 170000979
Problem Description
: Charger offline after remote update
Troubleshooting
:
We need to plan a site intervention to investigate the issue, as remote troubleshooting is not possible.
C
onsider the following potential causes:
Internet Issues with the Siemens Router:
The WAN may have switched from Cellular to Ethernet due to the failover function.
A
hard reset from OCPP
(if connected to an OCPP server) or a local reboot might restore connectivity.
Mobile Network Issues:
SIM card may be disabled or expired.
Monthly data volume might be exhausted.
Signal strength could be weak due to changing radio conditions.
Teltonika Router Issues:
Router may have switched to the wrong network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Potential hardware failure of the router.
Router software crash.
And please bring a spare router, SIM, and Ethernet cable during the intervention in case a replacement is needed.
Additionally, please take a
CFast (5.0.23)
with you, as a restore configuration may need to be performed if all other aspects have been verified.
Let me know if you need any further details.
For future reference, your case number is
0411340
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
